641:t_029:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「It's no use! We've missed the optimal timing for the extremely long-range teleportation!」

641:t_029:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Now we can't jump to the galactic center, even with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$' help!」

641:t_029:2.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「Damn it! Does that mean the whole plan's gone down the drain!?」

641:t_100:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Don't think a few $$サイデリアル$$ survivors can stop us!」

641:t_100:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「Out of the way! We'll scatter you and set off into the galaxy!」

641:t_101:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$サイデリアル$$...! You've come to stop us from venturing into the galaxy!」

641:t_101:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「But we'll overcome you and press on! To end all this fighting!」

641:t_102:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「We won't lose to $$サイデリアル$$ when you don't even have a $$リアクター$$!」

641:t_102:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Let's do this! We'll beat them here and head into the galaxy with no loose ends!」

641:t_103:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Damn you, $$サイデリアル$$! You're still after Earth!?」

641:t_103:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Go, $$鉄人$$! We'll completely defeat these enemies targeting Earth before we head into the galaxy!」

641:t_104:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's the Galactic Raid Fleet's departure ceremony, and these jerks can't take a hint!」

641:t_104:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「Come at me! I'll take out every last one of you who interferes with our departure!!」

641:t_105:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You never learn! Do you want us to beat the crap out of you that badly!?」

641:t_105:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You didn't have to come all this way! We were going to settle things with you at the galactic center anyway!」

641:t_106:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「Do you want Earth that badly!?」

641:t_106:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「If you're fighting $$バアル$$ too, we might be able to join forces!」

641:t_107:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「Fine by me! You still don't get that when you try to hold us down, it just makes us want to drill straight through!」

641:t_107:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「If you're going to get in our way, come prepared! My drill will punch right through you!」

641:t_108:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「The Galactic Raid Fleet is humanity's hope...! I'll protect it, no matter what!」

641:t_108:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I won't let you extinguish the flame of hope!」

641:t_109:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
(Big Sis... $$ノノ$$ will work hard enough for both of us. So...)

641:t_109:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
(Big Sis... $$ノノ$$ will work hard enough for both of us. So...)

641:t_109:2.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
(Big Sis... $$ノノ$$ will work hard enough for both of us. So...)

641:t_109:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
(We have to meet again in the galaxy! It's a promise, Big Sis!)

641:t_109:4.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
(We have to meet again in the galaxy! It's a promise, Big Sis!)

641:t_109:5.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
(We have to meet again in the galaxy! It's a promise, Big Sis!)

641:t_110:0.en:
$$葵$$
「It looks like you still haven't had enough punishment...」

641:t_110:1.en:
$$葵$$
「Then I'll go all the way! Until you never want to lay a hand on Earth again!」

641:t_111:0.en:
$$赤木$$
「Let's do this! We have to reach the galactic center and protect Earth... the universe!」

641:t_111:1.en:
$$赤木$$
「We don't have time to hang around here! Get out of the way!!」

641:t_112:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
(Even if they want Earth's $$次元力$$, do they really think they can win with these forces...?)

641:t_112:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
(Emperor $$アウストラリス$$... No, Dimensional General $$ヴィルダーク$$... What are you plotting...?)

641:t_113:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「You're persistent bastards! We already beat down your boss, $$ヴィルダーク$$!」

641:t_113:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「If you still don't get it, I'll teach you! Get a good taste of our power!」

641:t_114:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「We have to go to the galactic center! We can't stay stuck here!」

641:t_114:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「You're letting us through, $$サイデリアル$$! We're going to save the universe!」

641:t_115:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
「To protect Earth... the universe...! So we can live...!」

641:t_116:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「The Galactic Raid Fleet's battleships have microwave transmitters!」

641:t_116:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That means I can use the Satellite Cannon even away from the Earth Sphere...! Now I just have to use its power for what's right!」

641:t_117:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「You're still after Earth, even in a situation like this!?」

641:t_117:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Stop fighting! Why can't you see that this is no time for that!?」

641:t_118:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
(Something's been watching us for a while now...)

641:t_118:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
(What is this chill...? What's going to happen here...?)

641:t_119:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Damn it...! What the hell is behind these guys...!?」

641:t_119:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「This pressure I've been feeling...! Is it... $$ヴィルダーク$$...!?」

641:t_120:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Why can't you see that trying to settle everything by force like that destroys possibility!?」

641:t_120:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If you're fighting $$バアル$$ too, we should be able to cooperate!」

641:t_121:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「Can't we understand each other, even with the universe in danger...!?」

641:t_121:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「No... I won't give up...! I'll keep searching for that possibility as I fight!」

641:t_122:0.en:
$$シン$$
「Everything in the universe could be destroyed, and you still want to wage war!?」

641:t_122:1.en:
$$シン$$
「If you want to fight that badly, turn that power against $$バアル$$!!」

641:t_123:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「The place where we must fight is out in the galaxy...!」

641:t_123:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「We have to go there! Carrying the hopes and strength of everyone on Earth!」

641:t_124:0.en:
$$シャア$$
(Is this overwhelming pressure... coming from behind them...!?)

641:t_124:1.en:
$$シャア$$
(Is Dimensional General $$ヴィルダーク$$... coming here...!?)

641:t_125:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Target confirmed... Our attack target is $$サイデリアル$$.」

641:t_125:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
($$リリーナ$$... I'm heading out.)

641:t_126:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「We'll take you on at the galactic center!」

641:t_126:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「We'll settle everything there! With you, and with $$バアル$$!」

641:t_127:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「You guys! Do you still want to wage war!?」

641:t_127:1.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Cut out that stupid crap! And listen to my soooong!!」

641:t_128:0.en:
$$レド$$
「If we go to the galactic center, fighting $$サイデリアル$$ will be unavoidable...!」

641:t_128:1.en:
$$レド$$
「But we can't protect anything if we're afraid...! We're moving forward!」

641:t_129:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「You never make any progress! You're still clinging to a reckless strategy!」

641:t_129:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Get out of the way! We'll take you on at the galactic center!!」

641:t_130:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(This charge looks reckless at first glance...)

641:t_130:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(What is the enemy's objective? What comes after this?)

641:t_131:0.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I have no business with you.」

641:t_131:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Move aside. Don't block our path.」

641:t_132:0.en:
$$桂$$
「You never learn, do you!? And I'm sick of cheap tricks like attacking just before we leave!」

641:t_132:1.en:
$$桂$$
「Then bring it on! Let's settle things here before we head to the galactic center!」

641:t_133:0.en:
$n
「Damn it! If these guys attack Earth after we set sail...!」

641:t_133:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's all right, $n. That's what the Earth Defense Plan is for: to intercept them.」

641:t_133:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm sure the people who remain will protect Earth after we leave.」

641:t_133:3.en:
$n
「Then we'll move forward! To protect Earth and the universe!」

641:t_134:2.en:
$n
「...I'm all right, Miss $$スズネ$$... I'll fight to defeat my enemies... the enemies of Earth and the universe!」
